# Post-Event Review Template

Use after any incident, EOP activation, MOP backout, or near miss. The aim is to fix the system, not to blame a person.

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Event ID | |
| Date and time (start, stable, normal) | |
| Review lead | |
| Review date | |

## 1. Summary
Two or three sentences: what happened and what the effect was.

## 2. Timeline

| Time | Source (alarm log, person, trend) | What happened |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## 3. Impact
Load affected, redundancy lost and for how long, equipment damaged, people affected.

## 4. What worked
Automatic responses, procedures, and actions that helped.

## 5. What did not work
Equipment, procedures, training, communication, spares, or design that fell short.

## 6. Causes
Direct cause, contributing factors, and the underlying cause. Ask "why" until the answer is something that can be changed.

## 7. Actions

| # | Action | Owner | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | |

Include, where they apply: procedure revisions, training or drills, spares list changes, design or settings changes, vendor follow-up.

## 8. Sharing
Who needs to know (other shifts, other sites, vendors), with site-identifying details removed before sharing outside the organization.
